integrity: All formulas are proved from exact binomial ratios and a unitary Hadamard rotation; no numerical experiment, finite enumeration, or external certificate is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the canonical non-radial family \(\mu_{i,j}=\omega_{i+j}\sqrt{\binom{i+j}{i}}\), not arbitrary non-radial weights, and does not claim a complete \(\mathcal F\)-transitivity classification. An equivalent annihilation-operator formulation may exist in classical symmetric-Fock or multishift literature under different terminology.
title: Exact symmetric-Fock decomposition of a binomially weighted lattice backward shift
